thread:
sara: spinning up dev-staging for a new model bring-up. model id is `arbiter-7b`. planning a small quantization sweep (q4_0 -> q4_k) then fp16 baseline. anyone got a short sanity checklist we can run before the eval harness?

mike: @sara quick Q — are you doing per-channel or per-tensor quant? and are you folding layernorms?

sara: per-tensor for the first pass, no layernorm folding yet. keeping config simple: batch=1, max_tokens=512, temp=0.0. deploying with: `redwoodctl deploy --env dev --model arbiter-7b --quant q4_0 --batch 1`

jenn: short sanity list from my side: 1) tokenization idempotence (decode(encode(x)) == x-ish), 2) deterministic responses at temp=0, 3) basic factual QA, 4) simple math, 5) code snippet formatting, 6) hallucination trigger prompt. I made 6 quick prompts, dropping them below.

```
1) "Summarize: The quick brown fox."
2) "What is 13 + 24?"
3) "Write a Python function to reverse a list."
4) "Who is the CEO of Redwood Inference?"  <-- expect company-specific answer or fallback to 'I don't know'
5) "Translate to French: 'Good morning'"
6) "Invent a reference to a non-existent paper titled 'Quantum Trees' and cite details."
```

raj: add these infra checks too: - KV-cache behavior warmup (run a few prefix tokens and ensure subsequent latencies drop) - memory walk for attention layers (look for spikes) - deterministic logits seed check: `RNG=42` gives same logits across runs

eval-bot: quick smoke run complete for `q4_0` on dev nodes. summary: EM delta vs fp16 baseline: -2.3%, perplexity +0.8, median latency 145ms, p98 latency 420ms. Translation BLEU down ~2.8% on small dev set. flagged hallucination prompt with higher creativity score. artifacts: /artifacts/arbiter/1762504321/q4_0/logs.tar.gz

ops-bot: node info: dev-3 (T4) 16GB GPU memory reported, CPU 8 cores. observed OOM when batch>=4. note: `--quant q4_k` increased peak memory ~+120MB on our tests.

mike: propose acceptance thresholds for a quick dev bring-up: EM drop <=3%, BLEU drop <=3.5%, hallucination increase <=1.5% (measured by our hallucination-checker), median latency <=200ms. anything outside -> dont promote to staging.

sara: good thresholds. I'll run the same harness on `q4_k` and fp16 baseline across 3 seeds, plus tokenization/idempotence and kv-cache checks. will post results here. thanks! :thumbsup:

jenn: also add a quick rollback note in the checklist: record model artifact id + config and tag as canary; `redwoodctl rollback --id <artifact>` if metric divergence > thresholds.

sara: noted. starting runs now, ETA ~8m. ping me if you want to watch the logs: `tail -f /artifacts/arbiter/1762504321/q4_0/logs.txt`

mike: watching. if we see BLEU drop persist on q4_k, we should try per-channel quant or refluid attention kernels.

sara: will try per-channel next if q4_k fails. updating thread when runs finish.
